args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with **unhealthy** status and an **18% error rate**.
- Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, paging the on-call engineer, describing the v2.3.1 regression and the rollback.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status: **v2.3.0 healthy** in all regions, error rate down to **0.2%**.

The incident remains open for root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
